import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_data = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. BMI Category Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax2.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=sns.color_palette("Set2"), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, 
                color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(occupation_sleep)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(x=7, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5, label='7 hours')
ax3.legend()
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Stress Level vs Physical Activity
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
           c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax4.collections[0], ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax5.hist(subset['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.6, bins=20, label=gender, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
correlation = df[['Daily Steps', 'Quality of Sleep']].corr().iloc[0, 1]
ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Quality of Sleep'], alpha=0.5, c=colors[0], s=50)
z = np.polyfit(df['Daily Steps'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax6.plot(df['Daily Steps'].sort_values(), p(df['Daily Steps'].sort_values()), 
        "r--", linewidth=2, alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title(f'Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality\n(r={correlation:.2f})', 
             fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
